_comment: cqf-skills (litlfred fork) takes the shape smart-trust-tools does: index.config.json pins the harness layers it needs (fhir-harness and the layers below it); they are laid down from index.lock.json and gitignored. Only the workspaces and the harness entry point are declared here; upstream's own tooling is Python and needs none of this.
name: @litlfred/cqf-skills
_workspaces_comment: The mounted code layers, as workspaces, as litlfred/smart-trust-demo lists them: they import each other by package name and nothing publishes those packages.
_overrides_comment: Copied from litlfred/smart-trust (2026-10-15): fhir-harness's fhirclient reaches expo through an optional dependency whose latest peer does not resolve; pinned to the version folio-assistant's bun.lock resolves.
